dimension_assessments.summary: All contracted primitives, arbitrary nonnegative finite caps and positive wages are quantified. The conclusion includes entire household, value, policies and law equality, plus the exact signed supply difference.

The normalization bridge justifies cap-independent primitives. Definitional equality and proof irrelevance identify canonical objects; two valid A02 accounting identities reduce the supply difference to -(b2-b1) by ring algebra.

Resources are cash available for consumption and shifted next assets; next resources equal R*A+w*l at zero rate. The stationary law is a resource law, while supply integrates shifted asset policy minus the cap. Original and shifted asset policies are correctly distinguished.

Visually inspected A94 extraction pp.1–3 map to printed 666,672,673/original PDF 9,15,16. Equation (2) and p.672 support the exact zero-rate claim. Canonical transport is labeled reconstruction; A93 has no invented extension locator.

BASIC, smoothness, curvature and essential-endpoint nondegeneracy remain explicit; iid laws are constructed. S05/A02's impatience premise is derived. No density, labor normalization or stationary moment premise is added.

No premise assumes policy equality, stationarity, supply translation or the desired conclusion. Caps may be zero or equal; the normalization imposes no contradictory constraint. Stationary existence comes from accepted S05.

The proof follows P02/H02/H04/S05/A02. Changes add gate-local helpers, the thin wrapper and audits; the certified aggregator addition preserves accepted declaration fingerprints and introduces no cycle.

Resources remain NNReal and labor an arbitrary probability measure on a compact interval. Essential endpoints allow atoms; neither finite support nor a density is required. Product histories retain iid interpretation.

The argument uses no marginal object at zero or elsewhere. Household and policy equalities include zero resources without differentiating there; the mandatory separation of positive-state rightMarginalValue and ENNReal zeroRightMarginal is preserved.

A02 provides integrability of resources, shifted/net assets, consumption and effective income for the selected law. Its accounting identity uses proved finite asset integrals before subtracting the cap. E01 introduces no ENNReal-to-Real conversion or totalized-integral shortcut.

E01 compares exactly equal stationary laws and policies, not limits of distributions or moments. S05's convergence remains weak; stationary first-moment finiteness is supplied separately by A02, so no unsupported moment-convergence inference occurs.

Strict impatience follows from beta*1=beta<1 rather than an extra assumption. No consumption-positivity premise is introduced. Smoothness, curvature and nondegeneracy are exactly the authorized E01 conditions.

Inspected new proofs use ordinary definitional equality, accepted theorems and algebra. No sorry, admit, project axiom, native_decide or unsafe bypass appears; controller checks cover all 716 audited declarations.
Actual transitive axiom records for all nine new exports contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The complete 716-record audit has the same permitted union.

All nine source exports match signature and axiom inventories. Each has #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms in both audit files; the public wrapper preserves the full helper conclusion and premises.

The ledger matches the exact statement, assumptions, normalization, proof and scope. E01 remains REVIEW_READY and E02/E03 UNFORMALIZED. Controller documentation checks certify generated TeX/PDF synchronization.

Ignoring b in the shifted constructor is justified by a proved bridge to finiteCapPrices at r=0, where phi=b. Policies are accepted Bellman maximizers, the law is selected from proved invariant existence, and supply is the actual integral of A-b. Thus the reflexive equalities encode the intended economics.

No quantifier, conclusion or probability interpretation is weakened. The theorem retains exact equality and signed translation, the general iid law and all contracted regularity; no arbitrary invariant law is assumed.
Every new helper serves the zero-rate E01 identity. No positive-rate cap-equivalence, government-debt, monetary or growth theorem is added; E02 and E03 remain UNFORMALIZED.

The inspected proof, normalization and accounting semantics satisfy E01; source inspection and complete export audits support acceptance. No blocker remains. Controller promotion alone determines GREEN.
